# Noise Texture

Creates repeatable three-dimensional fractal gradient noise.

`lfs.noise_texture` · Texture

## How to use

Vector defaults to Position. Detail supports fractional octaves from 0 to 15.\
Roughness controls the amplitude of successive octaves.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vector | `Vector` | lfs.vector | — | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Coordinates used to evaluate noise. |
| Scale | `Scale` | lfs.float | 5 | min 0; step 0.1; accepts per-element values | Coordinate scale. |
| Detail | `Detail` | lfs.float | 2 | min 0; max 15; step 0.1; accepts per-element values | Number of octaves, with fractional blending. |
| Roughness | `Roughness` | lfs.float | 0.5 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Amplitude retained by each octave. |
| Distortion | `Distortion` | lfs.float | 0 | min 0; step 0.1; accepts per-element values | Amount of coordinate warping. |
| Seed | `Seed` | lfs.float | 0 | step 1; accepts per-element values | Offset selecting a repeatable noise pattern. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fac | `Fac` | lfs.float | — | — | Noise value from 0 to 1. |
| Colour | `Colour` | lfs.colour | — | — | Grayscale noise colour. |
